suite.doc:
Sequential journey test suite for the middle wizard steps: - /applicant-basic-details (TC-8001–TC-8010) - /onboarding (TC-9001–TC-9003) - /applicant-personal-details (TC-10001–TC-10010) - /applicant-residential-details (TC-11001–TC-11010)
New pages — no Java TC coverage. Tests run sequentially in wizard order. Each section advances the wizard before the next section's tests begin.
Session model: Suite Setup → Navigate To Applicant Basic Details Test Setup → NONE (tests run in strict wizard order; [Setup] set per section) Test Teardown → NONE (shared session) Suite Teardown → Close Browser
PRECONDITION: ${APP_CREATION_MOBILE} must be registered on UAT. All APP_* variables must be correctly set in variables.robot. Satisfies: RT-5, B2 (new-page coverage), T1, T5 (TN4 static/computed assertions), U1

suite.doc:
Bypass Authentication test suite for the GQ Customer Portal. Tests the /instant-eligibility page used for tokenised ERP access without OTP.
The page authenticates via bypassAuthPost using a mobile number in the ?m= query param. On success → redirects to /my-applications or /student-details. Without ?m= → redirects immediately to / (login page). On bypassAuthPost failure → shows no-account error state with Sign In button.
TC-403 and TC-404 require a mobile number that fails bypassAuthPost (no ERP account). These are tagged robot:skip pending identification of a suitable UAT test mobile.
Satisfies: TC-401 to TC-404

suite.doc:
Test suite for the GQ Customer Portal Choose Plan page (/choose-plan). Ported from GQCP-TC-6001 to TC-6011 (SelectPlanTest + SelectPlanTestClass2, Java/Selenium).
Session model: Suite Setup → Navigate To Choose Plan (creates app + fills student details) Test Setup → Navigate To Choose Plan Within Session Test Teardown → NONE (shared session) Suite Teardown → Close Browser TC-6008 (plan selection + proceed) runs last — it advances the wizard.
PRECONDITION: ${APP_CREATION_MOBILE} must be registered on UAT and have eligible plans. A "no plans" result indicates account data seeding need, not a test defect. Satisfies: RT-3, B1 (Java TCs ported), T1, U2, U3

suite.doc:
Test suite for the GQ Customer Portal Confirm Application page (/confirm-application). Ported from GQCP-TC-13001 to TC-13025 (ConfirmApplicationTest + ConfirmApplicationTestClass2 + ConfirmApplicationTestClass3, Java/Selenium).
Session model: Suite Setup → Navigate To Confirm Application (full wizard traversal, salaried path) Test Setup → Navigate To Confirm Application Within Session (Go To) Test Teardown → NONE (shared session) Suite Teardown → Close Browser TC-13023 (proceed + consent) runs LAST — it submits the application.
PRECONDITION: All APP_* variables must match the data entered during wizard traversal. Static field assertions use Should Be Equal As Strings (TN4 resolution). API-computed fields (EMI amount, interest rate) use Should Not Be Empty or Should Match Regexp.
Satisfies: RT-7, B1 (Java TCs ported), T1, T5 (TN4 static/computed assertions), U1, U4 (edit button navigation)

suite.doc:
Dashboard test suite for the GQ Customer Portal (/my-applications). Covers TC-4001 to TC-4031: header, tab navigation, profile menu, EMI content, Transaction History filters, and download functionality. Ported from gq_customer_ui_automation (Java/Selenium) DashboardTestClass1-4.
PRECONDITION (TN2 resolution B): The UAT test account (8108556708) must have: - At least one active EMI application for TC-4001 and TC-4011 to be assertable. - At least one transaction record for TC-4013 through TC-4031 to be assertable. A failure indicating "no data found" signals an account seeding need, not a test defect.
Session model (O1 + TN4 + TN1 resolutions): Suite Setup: Opens browser, logs in once, lands on /my-applications. Test Setup: Navigates to /my-applications (resets tab/filter/dropdown/scroll state). Test Teardown: NONE — shared session is preserved between tests (no Close Context). Suite Teardown: Closes browser. ⚠ TC-4009 (logout) MUST remain the final test in this file (TN1 resolution). Robot Framework executes tests in file order; the logout test destroys the session.

suite.doc:
Test suite for the GQ Customer Portal Employment pages: - /select-employment (TC-12001–TC-12016) - /applicant-employment-details (Salaried: TC-12017–TC-12046) - /applicant-employment-details (Self-Employed: TC-12047–TC-12094)
Session model: Suite Setup → Navigate To Employment Type (creates app + full wizard traversal) Per-test Setup → Varies by section (see [Setup] tags below): Employment Type tests: Navigate To Employment Type Within Session Salaried tests: Navigate To Salaried Employment Details In Session Self-Employed tests: Navigate To Self Employed Details In Session Test Teardown → NONE (shared session) Suite Teardown → Close Browser TC-12045 (salaried proceed) and TC-12092 (self-employed proceed) run last per variant.
Ported from: GQCP-TC-12001–TC-12094 (SelectEmploymentTest + SalariedEmploymentTest + SelfEmploymentTest + classes, Java/Selenium) Satisfies: RT-6, B1 (Java TCs ported), T1, T4 (dual-variant), TN3 resolution

suite.doc:
Login left panel component test suite for the GQ Customer Portal. Tests the branding/navigation panel on the left side of the login page. Ported from loginLeftComponentTest.java in gq_customer_ui_automation.
Left panel elements: - GrayQuest logo (SVG) - "Register for EMI Plans" headings - Subheading info paragraph - "Trusted by 5M+ Parents" image - Footer links: About Us, Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Contact Us - Copyright notice
All tests share a single browser context — the left panel is static and does not change between interactions, so re-navigation is only done for new-tab tests. Suite Setup navigates to the login page once. Individual tests re-open the login page via Test Setup where new-tab handling requires a fresh context.
Satisfies: TC-101 to TC-109

suite.doc:
Login test suite for the GQ Customer Portal. Tests the mobile number login form at https://customer.uat.graydev.in.
Form collects: mobile number (10-digit) + consent checkbox. There is NO email or password field — all tests use mobile number. On valid submission: calls checkMobilePost API → navigates to /verify.
Covers: - Core login scenarios (valid, empty, invalid format, short, no consent) - URL and title verification - Field visibility and editability - Input validation (spaces, alphabets, alphanumeric, special chars, max length) - OTP redirect with valid mobile numbers - Consent form navigation links (T&C, Privacy Policy) - Send OTP button enabled/disabled states
Ported from gq_customer_ui_automation (Java/Selenium) — loginPageTest.java. Satisfies: TC-201, TC-207 to TC-220 (excluding TC-202 to TC-206 in left component suite)
Satisfies: B1 (mobile form, not email/password), B2 (full login coverage), B3 (UAT target), U1 (exact error messages), U3 (redirect assertions), S1 (credentials in variables file), O1 (dry-run safe), O2 (results output)

test.doc: Entering the correct UAT OTP (9999) should call verifyOtpPost, set auth tokens, redirect to /my-applications, and display the dashboard greeting "Hello,". Intentionally runs BEFORE Wrong OTP — a prior failed verifyOtpPost call can trigger IP rate limiting that blocks the valid OTP path. Handles UAT verifyOtpPost rate limiting: polls for redirect up to LONG_TIMEOUT, then if still not redirected waits RATE_LIMIT_WAIT and retries based on page state: - /my-applications → already succeeded, skip retry - /verify (OTP form visible) → re-enter OTP and click Verify - / (login page) → re-submit login form then OTP (rate limit forced full logout) Satisfies: B2 (valid OTP coverage), U3 (redirect assertion), T3, TN2 (fixed OTP 9999)

test.doc: Submitting a structurally valid but incorrect OTP (e.g. "1234") calls verifyOtpPost, which returns an error. The user remains on /verify. Primary assertion: URL stays on /verify (verifies wrong OTP does not authenticate). Secondary assertion: "Incorrect OTP" toast visible — non-blocking because in UAT verifyOtpPost can be rate-limited after prior calls, returning 429 instead of the wrong-OTP error response, so no toast appears. Rate limit does not change the core behaviour (user stays on /verify either way).

test.name: Resend OTP After Timer Expires
test.doc:
After the 180-second countdown, the Resend OTP link (data-testid='resend-otp-link') should become visible. Clicking it should trigger resendOtpPost API, reset the timer, and hide the resend link again.
WARNING: This test waits ~3 minutes. It is EXCLUDED from default CI runs. Run explicitly with: robot --include resend tests/otp_tests.robot Or include in nightly job: robot --include slow tests/ Satisfies: T4 (180s timer boundary), B2 (resend coverage), TN1 (slow tag decision)

suite.doc:
OTP Verification test suite for the GQ Customer Portal. Tests the 4-digit OTP form at https://customer.uat.graydev.in/verify.
UAT fixed OTP: 9999 — applies to all mobile numbers (TN2 resolution). No SMS dependency. Tests run reliably in CI without a gateway. OTP timer: 180 seconds before the Resend OTP link becomes visible (T4 boundary). Resend OTP test is tagged "slow" and "resend" — excluded from default CI runs (TN1 resolution). Run with: robot --include resend tests/otp_tests.robot
Covers: - Field visibility and editability - Input validation (empty, short OTP) - Button enabled/disabled states - Wrong OTP — URL stays on /verify; toast is best-effort (non-blocking if rate-limited) - Valid OTP redirect with dashboard greeting - Back button navigation and mobile number clearing - Mobile number display on OTP page - OTP countdown timer text - Resend OTP flow (slow — robot:skip, run with --include resend)
Ported from gq_customer_ui_automation (Java/Selenium). UAT rate limit: ~3 checkMobilePost calls per ~60s. Each test navigating to the OTP page uses a distinct mobile number. Navigate To OTP Page handles auto-retry on rate limit detection.
Satisfies: B2 (full OTP coverage), T3 (fixed OTP, no SMS), T4 (timer), T5 (4-digit OTP), U1 (exact error messages), U3 (redirect assertions), O1 (dry-run safe), O2 (results output), TN1, TN2

suite.doc:
Test suite for the GQ Customer Portal Select Applicant Type page (/select-applicant). Ported from GQCP-TC-7001 to TC-7011 (SelectApplicantTest + SelectApplicantTestClass2, Java/Selenium).
Session model: Suite Setup → Navigate To Select Applicant (creates app + traverses student-details + choose-plan) Test Setup → Navigate To Select Applicant Within Session Test Teardown → NONE (shared session) Suite Teardown → Close Browser TC-7008 (selection + proceed) runs last — it advances the wizard.
PRECONDITION: ${APP_CREATION_MOBILE} must be registered on UAT. Satisfies: RT-4, B1 (Java TCs ported), T1, U1, U2

suite.doc:
Test suite for the GQ Customer Portal Student Details page (/student-details). New page — no Java TC coverage. TC-5001 to TC-5014.
Session model: Suite Setup → Create Application And Navigate To Student Details Test Setup → Navigate To Student Details Within Session Test Teardown → NONE (shared session) Suite Teardown → Close Browser TC-5014 (submit with valid data) runs last — it advances the wizard to /choose-plan.
PRECONDITION: ${APP_CREATION_MOBILE} must be registered on UAT. Satisfies: RT-2, B2 (new-page coverage), T1, U1
